videos.title: Rob — Maniac (Death Waltz Recording Company, 12" Frosted Clear Vinyl, 2014)
videos.description:
As is with many genre scores of recent times, Rob's score is heavily indebted to the synth sounds of the '80s. It's a really striking piece of work, absolutely grimy and sleazy and appropriately murderous, but with a real sense of melody.
